prompt: What adjustment is supported by the observations at Station 1?
promptZh: 第一站的觀察支持哪項調整？

options.text: Replace the label with the old version.
options.whyZh: 舊版沒有包裝指示，觀察也無法支持把新版換掉。

options.text: Ask operators to tip the holder as they read.
options.zh: 要求操作員讀標籤時把架子傾斜。
options.whyZh: 試驗中不允許傾斜標籤架，而且成功的做法是把標籤上移。

options.text: Move the packing instruction above the code.
options.zh: 把包裝指示移到代碼上方。
options.whyZh: 成功重測時沒有換標籤版面，所以無法據此建議移位置。

options.text: Raise the label in its holder before testing.
options.zh: 測試前把標籤在架內往上調。
options.whyZh: 擋條曾遮住包裝指示；把標籤上移後同一標籤架上的代碼和指示都看得清楚。

explanationZh: 擋條曾遮住包裝指示；把標籤上移後同一標籤架上的代碼和指示都看得清楚。
evidence: Nora read the code at Station 1 but could not read the instruction because the rail hid the bottom of the label. / A technician slid the label up and repeated the test, using the same holder.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Nora read the code at Station 1 but could not read the instruction because the rail hid the bottom of the label.
A technician slid the label up and repeated the test, using the same holder.

vocabulary.note: 用來固定標籤或其他物品的位置。
